        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_security_acl"><sys_security_acl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><admin_overrides>true</admin_overrides><advanced>true</advanced><applies_to/><condition table="sys_attachment">table_nameSTARTSWITHx_hccc_hoc_ohs_investigation_case^EQ<item endquery="false" field="table_name" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="STARTSWITH" or="false" value="x_hccc_hoc_ohs_investigation_case"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></condition><decision_type>deny</decision_type><description>HoC Occupational Health and Safety: &#13;
Allow users to access attachments attached to 'OHS Investigation case' records that they are allowed to read (for all ohs investigation case records unless otherwise specified below).&#13;
Allow users to access attachments attached to OHS Investigation case - Harassment and Violence records if the user can read the case and if they pass one of the following checks:&#13;
- user is part of the CEH-HRS-OHS Admin group&#13;
- user is part of the CEH-HRS-Respectful Workplace group&#13;
- user is listed in the assigned_to and hv_complainant_manager fields and the manager_involved field is 'yes'</description><local_or_existing>Local</local_or_existing><name>sys_attachment</name><operation display_value="read">read</operation><script><![CDATA[//Get the record to which the attachment is related to
var gr = new GlideRecord(current.getValue("table_name"));
gr.get(current.getValue("table_sys_id"));

//Check is the record is valid and user can read it
if (gr.hr_service.toString() === '11d78aa31bb201509fde86acdd4bcb0b') {
    var can_attach_hv = new x_hccc_hoc_ohs.HoCOHSMUtils().checkHVAttachmentPermissions(gr.sys_id);
    answer = gr.isValid() && gr.canRead() && can_attach_hv;
} else {
    answer = gr.isValid() && gr.canRead();
}]]></script><security_attribute/><sys_class_name>sys_security_acl</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>abigael.schonewille@Parlissi.gc.ca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-25 20:17:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>48b9a380fbd07a9895e5fb3f4eefdcc2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>sys_attachment</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_security_acl_48b9a380fbd07a9895e5fb3f4eefdcc2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>abigael.schonewille@Parlissi.gc.ca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-09-25 20:39:35</sys_updated_on><type display_value="record">record</type></sys_security_acl><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>48b9a380fbd07a9895e5fb3f4eefdcc2</id><sys_created_by>abigael.schonewille@Parlissi.gc.ca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-25 20:39:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>b38ea78cfb147a9895e5fb3f4eefdc08</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>abigael.schonewille@Parlissi.gc.ca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-09-25 20:39:07</sys_updated_on><table>sys_security_acl</table><use_es_latest>false</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update></payload>
